note: Every SFX file is normalised to the same event loudness (loudest 100 ms, K-weighted) = ref_event_lufs. Gain at placement = target_db_vs_voice + voice integrated LUFS - ref_event_lufs.

mix.why: SOUND.md: viral master -14.4 LUFS (-14.6 to -14.2), Jack -16.0; bed 13.3 dB under the voice (Jack 17.3 = too quiet); SFX -11.7 dB vs voice (-14.9 to -8.4), biggest hits -4.2; 20% of cuts get a sound (10 to 50%), starting on the cut; audible SFX 1.8 per 10 s measured, the detector undercounts 2 to 4x, so aim 4 to 5.
